meta.title: [EngSys] Enable rush build cache for @typespec/ts-http-runtime
meta.body_summary: Enable rush build cache for @typespec/ts-http-runtime by adding a rush-project.json config that extends the common repo cache configuration, claiming improved build times because many packages depend on it.

perf_labels.notes: Trivial config addition enabling build cache; minor newline fix in review, approved by multiple maintainers, no performance benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5 changed lines, this is a tiny configuration change by absolute volume. It fits a minimal, low-risk performance PR that merged naturally after a trivial style fix and multiple approvals.

review_details.concern_detail: The rush-project.json file lacked a trailing newline; jeremymeng flagged it as a code style requirement.
review_details.performance_claim: Enabling rush build cache for @typespec/ts-http-runtime will improve build times, especially in CI, since many downstream packages depend on it.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A trivial configuration addition that required no complex logic; merge gated only on a minor style fix, maintainer approvals, and CI enforcer checks.

detection_detail.code_reading: jeremymeng reviewed the new JSON file and requested a terminal newline.
detection_detail.ci_auto: jeremymeng triggered /check-enforcer evaluate and override to validate CI checks before merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or quantitative evidence for speedup was provided; maintainers accepted the narrative claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After inline review, Copilot added the missing newline in a follow-up commit.

core_change_summary.description: Added a single rush-project.json under sdk/core/ts-http-runtime/config/ that extends the common rush-project.json from the repo root, enabling Rush build caching for this package.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added rush-project.json with extends property.
Post-review: added missing newline at end of file per jeremymeng's comment.

Requested a newline at end of file.
